title: Feyenoord defender Mika Marmol: ‘Barcelona are always favourites to win the Champions League’
tweet: Mika Marmol, back at Camp Nou for his first Champions League game, will face Lamine Yamal but says Feyenoord cannot focus solely on the young striker. His familiarity with Barça’s players could give him a small edge, yet the Dutch side must stay collective. Barça’s status as a perennial favourite adds weight to the fixture but does not decide it.

title: From a €40m Chelsea target to priceless for Barcelona: Fermin Lopez unlocks another level
tweet: Fermin López’s season start—four goals, two assists, and a sharper final pass—shows he’s moved beyond a mere goal‑scoring midfielder; as Chelsea’s €40 m interest shifts to a likely €120 m plus, the real question remains: can Barça replace the unique blend of chaos and finish he now delivers?
